display_name: Zuora: Download SQL Data Query Result
description: Download a completed SQL Data Query job's result file to output_path. Reads the job, then fetches Zuora's own dataFile URL without the bearer token; a job not yet completed returns downloaded false with its queryStatus. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: Download the result file of a completed Zuora SQL Data Query job to an absolute path under the operator's export roots. The verb reads the job and fetches the result location Zuora itself issued, without sending the bearer token. A job still running returns downloaded false with its status.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora SQL data query result downloaded
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries downloaded, query_status, output_rows and file {path, bytes, sha256}; downloaded false means the job has not completed yet.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically. Credential values never appear; [REDACTED] marks where Zuora echoed one.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Download a completed SQL Data Query job's result file to output_path. Reads the job, then fetches Zuora's own dataFile URL without the bearer token; a job not yet completed returns downloaded false with its queryStatus.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape or an output/input path outside export_allowed_roots (zuora.export_path_refused). zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.validation_failed (vendor 4xx), zuora.query_failed (Data Query 4xx), zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the needed Workflow, Data Query or Files permission. Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write. Back off on rate limits.
